jobDescription:
Senior Account Manager (m/f/d) - Munich (hybrid)
We are a fast-growing logistics startup. You will manage key accounts and grow revenue.
What you'll need:
- 5+ years of experience in B2B sales
- A degree in business or a related field
- Business-fluent English and German
- Willingness to travel 2 to 3 days per week
- Full driving licence
What we offer: EUR 70,000 to 85,000 base plus OTE.
